title: Design: Close window asks for the original work order when required
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Use a location that is connected to QuickBooks Online, with every ShopView Accounts row mapped.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have a new no-charge work order of the regular customer, category Warranty, with no original work order, every line Complete, made for this test.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow2-11-4b-close-original-work-order-required.png, iwo-happy-27-27-close-original-work-order-required.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the no-charge work order.
  2. Click Close Work Order.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The work order opens.

Step 2:

  • Above the rows the select "Original work order *" (and "Original line") shows with the warning "Warranty requires the original work order. Pick the earlier work order this job comes from, or Not in ShopView."
  • Close Work Order is greyed out until one is picked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-R2: “When the category requires the original work order and none was picked, the confirmation shows the select "Original work order *" (and "Original line") above the rows with the warning "[Category] requires the original work order. Pick the earlier work order this job comes from, or Not in ShopView."; Close Work Order stays disabled until one is picked; Goodwill never shows this.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order" / "Happy flow v6", boards "4b Close · original work order required" (Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order), "27 Close · original work order required" (Happy flow v6).
